item.title: Footpath closed still, more than 2 years without being fixed, 21st July
item.description:
The alley behind Merestones close has been damaged for over 2 years, it has been fenced off but it is still not fixed. the path is subsiding into the brook. All of the alley ways around here are very overgrown and it looks like 'no mow May, June, July and August', same as many other places.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 7, Merestones Close, Warden Hill, Cheltenham
